name: Information Photonics
description: Mathematical preliminaries: introduction to Fourier transforms, sampling, usage of FFT for wave optics simulations; Fourier optics treatment of diffraction and imaging, brief introduction to optical coherence; imaging systems: coherent and incoherent imaging systems and their frequency response, MTF of digital imaging systems; PSF engineering by wavefront coding; 2D/3D image deconvolution; holographic imaging and 3D displays: on-axis and off-axis holography, hologram demodulation methods, holographic replay for 3D imaging, digital holography, algorithms for computer generated holograms; light-field imaging and display; super-resolution concepts; hyperspectral and polarization imaging.
